verdict.rationale: Mastra docs confirm agents can be deployed as a server and run in Node.js-compatible environments (including self-hosting for free), and the pricing page implies a paid/managed tier with enterprise controls, but there is no explicit documentation of a first-party 'managed runtime' product or concrete API-endpoint invocation pattern (e.g. REST/OpenAPI spec), and the openapi probe returned 404s everywhere. missing for 10: dedicated managed-hosting product docs, explicit REST/OpenAPI endpoint spec, independent confirmation of calling a deployed agent as an API.
